requirements.text: Implement colour-coding for different modules (e.g., lectures, tutorials, study time) in the personalised timetable
Allow hiding of cancelled classes in the personalised timetable for a clearer view
Provide automated notifications through the portal when new grades are posted
Send email notifications as a backup for grade alerts
Create a simple feedback form for module feedback covering content delivery, resource helpfulness, and lecturer engagement
Ensure the feedback form is concise and easy to complete
Focus on improving overall usability and clarity for students in the portal enhancements
Identify any potential technical constraints or university policies that may impact the implementation of the features
